name: Webcams
description: Live webcam streams and traffic cameras

content.urlOffline: This webcam URL appears to be offline or no longer available.

windy.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates via backend; browser loads Windy player/media directly when a live or timelapse embed is opened
windy.dataReceived: Webcam clusters/points with name, coordinates, thumbnail URL, stream URL, view count, categories

osm.dataSent: Bounding box coordinates via Overpass API
osm.dataReceived: OSM nodes with webcam URL, name, operator, direction

caltrans.dataSent: No user data (fetches district datasets, filtered server-side to bounding box)
caltrans.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with location, name, still image URL, route/direction

tfl.dataSent: No user data for catalog fetch; browser loads TfL video media directly when the video clip is displayed
tfl.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with name, coordinates, still image URL, video URL

nps.dataSent: No user data (fetches entire webcam catalog with pagination, filtered server-side to bounding box)
nps.dataReceived: Webcams with title, coordinates, image URL, streaming status, related park name/state, tags

dot-ny.dataSent: No user data for catalog fetch; browser loads 511NY HLS media directly when the live stream is opened
dot-ny.dataReceived: Traffic cameras with name, coordinates, snapshot URL, HLS video stream URL, roadway name, direction of travel
